en.hubeali: H 14842 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from one of our companions who said:

Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The Rasool Allahsaww did not speak to the servants in accordance with hissaww own reasoning and intellect, at all. The Rasool Allahsaww said: ‘The group of Prophetsas, weas have been Commanded that weas should speak to the people in accordance with their intellects’.
en.sarwar: 395. From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from one of our companions who said:

Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said: ‘The Rasool Allah (saww) did not speak to the servants in accordance with his (saww) own reasoning and intellect, at all. The Rasool Allah (saww) said: ‘The group of Prophets (as), we (as) have been Commanded that we (as) should speak to the people in accordance with their intellects’.
